title: Sankey diagram
summary: A Sankey diagram: quantities flowing between stages or categories, the nodes in columns by their longest path from where the flows start, a band from node to node as wide as its flow, a node in a chart colour and its bands in the light fill of it, names and values beside the nodes where they fit, a tooltip for a node or a band, a keyboard cursor over the nodes along the largest flows, a summary in words, and every flow as a row of a table.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: What the chart shows, in a few words: its accessible name and the table's caption. Required in practice: without it the chart is named «График».

source.description: The field of the flows' sources; source when unset.

target.description: The field of the flows' targets; target when unset.

value.description: The field of the flows' amounts, positive; the first numeric field other than the source and the target when unset.

labels.description: auto writes a node's name and value beside it, after it or, in the last column, before it, cut with an ellipsis to the room between the columns, when the node and its gap are a line high. none leaves them to the tooltip, the live line and the table.

tooltip.description: flow: under the pointer or the cursor, a node's name with what comes in and what goes out, or a band's source and target, its value and its share of the source.

y-format.description: The values' format: number, integer, decimal-<n>, compact, currency-<CODE> or unit-<unit>, in the page's language. Shares are always percent.

size.description: The rung of the size ladder: the plot's height, the text and the gaps. 1/2 for a card, 2 for a page of its own.

table.description: The same data as a table: toggle offers a button that swaps the plot for it, visible shows it under the plot, hidden keeps it for screen readers only. Never none: the table is the chart's text.

summary.description: auto: a sentence of what the data does (the nodes, the flows, the stages and the total that flows in, the largest flow with its share of the source, the node where the most arrives), said before the plot. The description slot adds the host's own words.

data-state.description: auto: ready with flows, empty without. loading draws the frame without marks; error offers «Повторить», which sends refresh.

items.description: The data: a list of records, one per flow ([{source, target, value}, …]), or an object of columns. The same pair named twice is one flow with the sum. A row without a source, a target or a positive value, or from a node to itself, is left out; a flow that would close a loop is left out too, because the diagram runs one way; the summary says how many.

colors.description: The colours of the nodes by name ({Бюджет: 'primary'}): a Framework role, which follows the theme, or any CSS colour or variable; anything else is dropped with a console report, as is a colour under 3:1 against the background (drawn all the same). A node without one takes the chart colour of its place, in the order the rows first name it; a band takes its source's colour, light.

sf-chart-sankey-select.summary: The person chose a node: a click on it, or Enter or Space on the keyboard cursor. index is its place in the order the rows first name it, node its name, value the larger of what comes in and what goes out, in and out those two.

sf-chart-sankey-refresh.summary: The person asked for the data again from the error state; the host loads it and sets items.

accessibility.focus: One Tab stop on the plot, then the table button. The summary is the plot's description; each cursor move is said politely.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chart-sankey to show how quantities flow between stages or categories: a budget split into its uses, traffic sources into pages and outcomes, energy from sources to consumers.
do_not: Do not draw a chart without a label
Do not use it for stage counts only; a sf-chart-funnel shows them
Do not use it for flows with loops: the diagram runs one way and leaves them out
